# Third-party vendors

## Kronos (K-line foundation model)

```bash
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos.git third_party/Kronos
```

AlphaDesk defaults to **NeoQuasar/Kronos-mini** + **NeoQuasar/Kronos-Tokenizer-2k** on CPU.
First forecast call downloads weights from Hugging Face (~tens of MB).
